easy.explain: good at = giỏi về (môn học, kỹ năng).

easy.q: My brother is afraid ___ the dark.
easy.explain: afraid of = sợ. 'afraid from' là lỗi dịch 'sợ từ'.

easy.q: This city is famous ___ its street food.
easy.explain: famous for + điều làm nên tiếng tăm.
full of; còn filled with. Không nói 'full with'.

easy.q: He is capable ___ running a marathon.
easy.explain: capable of + V-ing (có khả năng). Khác able to + V.

easy.q: I'm tired ___ eating the same food every day.
easy.explain: tired of = chán (việc gì). tired from = mệt vì (thể chất).

easy.q: She is married ___ a famous actor.
easy.explain: be married to sb. Không nói 'married with'.

easy.q: This region is rich ___ oil and gas.

normal.q: Don't be angry ___ me – it wasn't my fault!
normal.explain: angry with + NGƯỜI; angry about + SỰ VIỆC.

normal.q: Fruit and vegetables are good ___ you.
normal.explain: good for = tốt cho (sức khỏe). good at = giỏi; good to = tử tế với.

normal.q: My grandmother was always very good ___ us when we were kids.
normal.explain: good to sb = tử tế, đối xử tốt với ai (= kind to).

normal.q: I feel sorry ___ him – he just lost his job.
normal.explain: feel sorry for sb = thương, tội nghiệp ai.

normal.q: Sorry ___ the noise last night – we had a party.
normal.explain: sorry about + sự việc = xin lỗi / tiếc về chuyện gì.

normal.q: Mr Hung is responsible ___ the sales department.
normal.explain: responsible for sth = chịu trách nhiệm về việc gì.

normal.q: We're very grateful ___ you for all your help.
normal.explain: grateful TO sb FOR sth = biết ơn ai về việc gì.

normal.q: My legs hurt – I'm tired ___ running all morning.
normal.explain: tired from = mệt (thể chất) vì. tired of = chán.

normal.q: Da Lat is famous ___ the city of flowers.
normal.explain: famous as + vai trò / danh xưng. famous for + điều làm nên tiếng tăm.

normal.q: Everyone is anxious ___ news of the missing climbers.
normal.explain: anxious for = mong mỏi (tin tức). anxious about = lo lắng về.

hard.q: He is very sensitive ___ criticism, so be careful what you say.
hard.explain: sensitive to = nhạy cảm với (lời chê, ánh sáng, nhiệt độ…).

hard.q: It was very kind ___ you to help me move house.
hard.explain: It's + adj (kind, nice, silly, careless…) + OF sb + to V: nhận xét về con người.

hard.q: Tìm lỗi sai: Ms Lan (A) is responsible (B) of the new class, and she is (C) popular (D) with the students.
hard.explain: responsible FOR sth (chịu trách nhiệm về). popular with sb là đúng.

hard.q: I'm not familiar ___ this software. Can you show me how it works?
hard.explain: NGƯỜI + be familiar WITH sth = người biết rõ cái gì.

hard.q: Her face looks familiar ___ me, but I can't remember her name.
hard.explain: VẬT + be familiar TO sb = cái gì quen thuộc với ai (đảo chủ ngữ so với familiar with).

hard.q: She was disappointed ___ her test results.
hard.explain: disappointed with/about sth (hoặc in sb) = thất vọng về.

hard.q: Tìm lỗi sai: He is (A) different (B) with his brother, but they are both (C) keen (D) on football.
hard.explain: different FROM (không phải with). keen on là đúng.
proud of ✓ · jealous OF · addicted TO · aware OF.

hard.q: The book is mainly concerned ___ the history of Hanoi.
hard.explain: concerned with = liên quan đến, đề cập. concerned about = lo ngại về.

hard.q: My parents were disappointed ___ me for lying to them.
hard.explain: disappointed IN sb = thất vọng về ai; disappointed with/about sth.
